### [2026-05-12] Matched-seed Error Overlap（配对 seed 分析，3 seeds）
- 3 matched pairs: seed 0/42/456, 每组 1890 samples
- Mean CLS acc: 87.83%, Mean CWM acc: 87.35%
- **Oracle accuracy: 90.14%**（+2.31pp over CLS, +2.79pp over CWM）
